description.value: Wholesale Club is a Canadian bulk and wholesale grocery chain operated by Loblaws, catering to both businesses and value-focused shoppers with a wide selection of foodservice and household staples. The Kingsway location in Burnaby/Vancouver carries grocery, produce, meat, dairy, frozen, bakery, and snack categories, making it a practical large-format resupply stop on a busy arterial route. Membership is available but the no-fee business membership option makes access relatively straightforward.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (8 spaces) at 80m. Total: 8 spaces.
